name: Summer Camp at Newport Art Museum
street_address: 26 Liberty Street (Coleman Center for Creative Studies)
description_short: Weekly art camps at the Newport Art Museum's school on Liberty Street. Each week has a theme drawn from the museum's exhibitions and collection, with hands-on projects, gallery visits and games, and ends with a small Friday show of camper work.
special_needs_notes: Families needing accommodations should contact the Director of Museum Education at registration, ideally two weeks ahead. Campers must be fully potty trained. Staff cannot give medication.
refund_policy_summary: Refund up to two weeks before the camp starts, less a $25 processing fee. No refunds for missed days or for children removed for behavior.
